designDisposition: Prefer fixed session stages plus nested verifier substages in the same change; a session-only deployment stage would still hide a large set of verifier checks.

Reuse the existing onProgress path; record latest closed projection in private-dialog data attributes and copy it into the existing browser result before teardown. Preserve generic product error wording.

Omit RPC response listeners/counters and import-only scenario for this first diagnostic. The existing3-proof scenario reproduces the same deployed/updated chain context and failure boundary with less source/lifecycle change.
A changed diagnostic run is useful only when it captures exact failed phase/code and retains all existing acceptance. It is not a functional repair or automatic repeat authorization.
requirements: Use bounded constant stage/substage/status enums; unknown errors map to a fixed unknown category. Never pass arbitrary error.code/name/message/stack or request/response values into progress/DOM/report. Avoid invoking arbitrary getters merely to classify.

Snapshot fresh detached primitive observation records; callbacks and observation failure must not authorize success, change account/context state, suppress original errors or replace cleanup failures.
Preserve current verifyRollingDeployment sanitizing error behavior and20s deadline; preserve session exception identity, original/falsy throws, leases, await/guard order and PXE/store cleanup.

Nested failure stage must survive outer deployment/session catch without being overwritten by a generic later diagnostic; initialization diagnostics must not be confused with financial submitting/estimating progress.
Clear or associate observations with each actual session attempt/account lifecycle so a stale prior stage cannot be presented as the current failure. Do not reconnect/retry automatically.

Driver must validate a closed projection, snapshot before closing page/context and retain original outcome if diagnostic capture fails. No raw exception, URL, address, key, body or arbitrary object serialization.
requiredComponentCoverage: Inject each constructor group and nested deployment group failure including falsy values; verify exact last failure phase and original failure/cleanup semantics.
Hostile private sentinel codes/messages/stacks/accessors cannot enter progress, DOM or report; unknown/wrong types remain fixed unknown.
Throwing observation callback, DOM missing/malformed/stale attributes and browser diagnostic snapshot failure cannot produce success or bypass cleanup.
Successful full initialization reaches ready; account invalidation and late abort retain original lock/lifetime behavior.
futureExecutionGates: Exact source review, focused unit/actual Chromium component checks and normal wallet/frontend source-output closure required.
Separately reviewed one-shot existing genuine journey may be eligible after those gates; no time saving, guaranteed reproduction or product acceptance presumed.
If same-context diagnostic cannot discriminate the failure, choose next experiment from new evidence rather than broadening instrumentation speculatively.
limitations: 29privateRequests counts HTTP requests across allowed nonpublic origins including OPTIONS and batch requests, not29 node method calls.
Native actor supplies deployment directly, so genuine native writes do not qualify the browser deployment verifier.
Failure receipt lacks final worker fees/accounting; no retrospective acceptance.
